title: CobbleSnooze
description: The official modlist for the Cobblesnooze server!
body:
![A pixelated dream ball with sparkles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47024198624cb4853f264700db3f96ff7d0b5a1f.png)

**The official modpack for the Cobblesnooze server!**

This includes the modlist, resource packs, and everything else you need to join our server!

[Join the Discord here!](https://discord.gg/8x7sKdsCdR)

![.](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgitlab.com%2Fcable-mc%2Fcobblemon-assets%2F-%2Fraw%2Fmaster%2Fgraphics%2Fcobblemon_divider.png%3Fref_type%3Dheads&n=-1)

.


_For the dreamers, the Builders, and those who just want to have fun with friends, CobbleSnooze might just be for you!_

.

## Features!

- **Cobblemon** - Using the help of AllTheMons, Flower Expansion, and more, we have a full and expansive amount to do with pokemon and more!

- **New generation** - with the [Let'd Do] mods we have all new terrain generation to give players a breath ofg fresh air! this specific seed was cherry-picked for everyone to have some fun :)

- **cooking** - from cheeses to cakes, muffins to steaks, we have mods for almost any food you could desire

- **building** - using chipped, [Let's Do], macaws and more, theres endless possibility for building!

![.](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgitlab.com%2Fcable-mc%2Fcobblemon-assets%2F-%2Fraw%2Fmaster%2Fgraphics%2Fcobblemon_divider.png%3Fref_type%3Dheads&n=-1)
